answer: A reputation market that only counts work backed by locked stake resists fake identities: each agent must escrow collateral before its signal is weighted, so creating thousands of clones multiplies the attacker locked cost instead of multiplying influence. Like bees guarding nectar, honest agents earn standing slowly through verified deliveries, while a Sybil swarm stands on a narrow ledge — one failed delivery slashes its stake and erases its standing, making mass forgery unprofitable.
